gin-sear-decode-constraintGINBUILTLINKED 2026-10-04GIN's SEAR layer constrains every generated token, at decode time, to continue a span that occurs verbatim in the retrieved corpus, using a custom llama-cpp-python logits processor.That the constrained output is correct or fair to its source. sear-demo-pipelineSEARBUILTLINKED 2026-10-09sear-demo is a corpus-grounded answer pipeline with a verification gate: the model writes freely, then each claim must be entailed by its cited chunk (NLI) and every name and number must appear in it, or the claim is dropped; an explicit failure state replaces guessing.Decode-time constraint: this is SEAR's verify-after stage, not GIN's decode-time mask.
